selected_evidence.summary: Direct requests to the managed node IP returned HTTP 200 with the exact body; Apache was active and listening on port 8080 before and after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID 4c08f044-d5c3-4e1f-ba38-c70d1978253b, and confirmed the enabled service, listener, file content, HTTP response, firewall rule, and SELinux mapping recovered.
